headline: Approved two policy reads and voted to expel a student pending parent availability
summary: The committee approved the second read of several policies with two edits and the first read of policy BDB, both by 9-0 votes. It also entered executive session for a student disciplinary hearing and voted 9-0 to expel the student until a parent is available.
decisions: Approved the 2nd read of seven policies (BDA, BE, EBCA, EBCF, JJIF, JLF, JLF-E) with 2 edits, 9-0.
Approved the 1st read of policy BDB – School Committee Officers, 9-0.
Voted to enter executive session to conduct a disciplinary hearing for Student A, 9-0.
Voted to expel the student until a parent is available, 9-0.

Motion to enter into executive session to conduct Student A disciplinary hearing [Title 20-A §1001(9) and Title I §405 (6) (B)]. Janet Beaudoin – Meghan Hird (9-0)
Motion to expel until parent is available. (M.W.) Janet Beaudoin – Meghan Hird (9-0)

PROCEDURAL RULES 
 Superintendent Jake Langlais presented. No motion to approve procedural rules. 
 The Superintendent will update to align to changes in policy. 
 
REPORT FROM SCHOOL COMMITTEE CHAIR 
 Chairperson shared that we need more time for some of the agenda items that had been requested. 
 
REPORT FROM SCHOOL SUPERINTENDENT 
Superintendent Jake Langlais reported on the St. George visit regarding programming. We submitted a 
Nellie Mae grant. Students with permission slips visited the Black Poster Project by LHS kids. 
 
REPORT FROM CITY COUNCIL REP 
 None

- Bathroom engineering design 
- Blinking light repairs/research 
- Lighting upgrades 
- Alarm at Montello is done. 
- Montello canopy repair. 
 
SCHOOL COMMITTEE COMMUNITY ANNOUNCEMENTS 
 Lynnea reported on bad driving by many drivers in the community. She asked people to stay safe and don’t 
 drive tired. Pre-K parents need to be at the door to receive student. 
 Friday is the last Art Walk.  
 The Rally for Recovery is Saturday.  
 The armory shared the “Rec House” programs $10/day with some transportation. After school at the Armory 
 Wednesday & Thursday until 4:00 pm.  Check programs out online.
